title: Boasetɔ a Ɛtraa Awerɛhow
intro: Ɔpanyin bi a ne boasetɔ bɛyɛɛ anansesɛm, a n’anisoadehu yerae esiane awerɛhow nti, nanso ne gyidi wɔ ɔsoro nhyehyɛe no mu anhinhim da. Saa ankorankoro yi hwɛɛ mmabarima dumien a wɔrenyin abɛyɛ mmusuakuw fapem, ohuu abofra a wɔdɔ no kɛse a ɔhweree no yaw, na ɔbɛyɛɛ boasetɔ fɛfɛ ho sɛnkyerɛnne a enni bere mu wɔ awerɛhow a ɛboro so anim. Ɔkra a wobu no a wɔka n’asɛm wɔ adiyisɛm nkratafa nyinaa so. So wobɛtumi ahunu saa akontabuo yi afiri Kur’aan mu?
clues: Na meyɛ odiyifoɔ a wɔka n’asɛm kɔ akyiri wɔ Kur’aan surah kɛseɛ bi mu.
Na mewɔ mmabarima dumien a wɔbɛyɛɛ Bani Israel mmusuakuo agyanom.
Meka kyerɛɛ me mmabarima no sɛ wɔnfa apon ahorow mu nkɔ mu, anyɛ saa a wobehu wɔn sɛ wɔyɛ nnipa a wonni ahokafo.
M’aniwa yɛɛ fitaa esiane osu a minnyae wɔ abofra bi a medɔ no a wogye fii me nsam ho nti.
Mepowee sɛ mɛma abasamtuo mpo berɛ a me mmammarima afoforɔ no hyɛɛ me sɛ menyɛ saa, na wɔkaa sɛ me nwiinwii kyerɛ Allah nko ara.
Meyɛ odiyifo Yusuf a ne din ankasa kyerɛ ‘nea ɔma nneɛma yɛ kɛse’ wɔ Arabic kasa mu no agya.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
